in_sanskrit.name: तन्मय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Tanmay is derived from the Sanskrit word 'tanmatra' which means 'touchable, palpable, tangible'. In Hindu mythology, the tanmatras are the subtle, elementary forms of the five primary elements (Panchamahabhootas) – earth (Prithvi), water (Jal), fire (Agni), air (Vayu), and ether or space (Akash). They are also referred to as the 'manifestations of the senses' as they represent the qualities or attributes that can be perceived by our senses.
